turns.answer:
I've done a fair bit of logo and identity work over the years — from a standalone collection of used and unused marks to full product branding.

[[casestudies]]

The Vaiie branding was a nice one: the mark came from the word itself — Jersey French for "to see" — worked into an iris device. And there's a set of odds and ends, logos that made it out and some that didn't, if you fancy a rummage.
